applicant.name: Dr. Felix Wagner
applicant.organisation: University hospital, clinical decision support group

request.requested_format: pseudonymised data in a secure processing environment
request.purpose: We develop and validate a clinical decision-support algorithm. Summary tables are insufficient because the algorithm is evaluated per patient; only model parameters and evaluation metrics are exported.
request.question: Provide pseudonymised conditions, medications and HbA1c values for adults with type 2 diabetes who have at least one HbA1c value. We will only export model weights and performance metrics.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Cohort = adults with type 2 diabetes who have at least one HbA1c value (LOINC 4548-4).
Report the size of the cohort you would make available.
